newsitem.title: RWANDA: Thousands of Rwanda refugees flee home from Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Thousands of Rwanda refugees flee home from Zaire.

text.p: Between 5,000 and 10,000 Rwandan refugees fled into Rwanda from eastern Zaire on Sunday morning, a spokesman for the U.N. refugee agency UNHCR said.
"We have between 5,000 and 10,000 refugees crossing from Goma, at the border point at Mutura," UNHCR spokesman Paul Stromberg said in the Rwandan capital Kigali.
"We have deployed 20 trucks to help with transport and 250,000 litres (55,000 gallons) of water. There were also reports last night that Katale was attacked but we have no further reports," he said.
Stromberg did not specify who had attacked Katale, a town outside Goma in eastern Zaire.
It was the first significant return of Rwandan Hutu refugees into Rwanda since the current crisis began.
